--admin-check-only.help: Only check check if principals are admin

--admin-only.help: Only return paths that lead to an admin role - much faster

--all-objects.help: Report ALL objects, not just sensitive files (implies --no-limit unless --max-objects is set)

--all-profiles.help: Use all AWS CLI profiles in AWS credentials file

--all-projects.help: Automatically discover and target all accessible projects

--arn-ignore-list.help: File containing a list of ARNs to ignore separated by newlines

--cached.help: Load cached data from disk. Faster, but if changes have been recently made you'll miss them

--cols.help: Comma separated list of columns to display in table output

--days.help: How many days of CloudTrail events should we go back and look at.

--dependencies.help: Analyze resource dependencies and cross-project relationships

--extended.help: Enable extended enumeration (impersonation targets, privilege escalation paths)

--flat-output.help: Use legacy flat output structure instead of hierarchical per-project directories

--foxmapper-path.help: Custom path to FoxMapper data directory

--groups.help: Comma-separated list of known group email addresses (used when group enumeration is permission denied)

--groupslist.help: Path to file containing group email addresses (one per line)

--hours.help: Hours of logs to scan (default 168 = 7 days)

--iam.help: Check IAM policies for public access

--ignore-cache.help: Disable loading of cached data. Slower, but important if changes have been recently made

--include-kms.help: Include KMS keys in the output

--list-rgs.help: Drill down to the resource group level

--log-name.help: Optional: filter to a specific log name

--max-entries.help: Maximum log entries to process per project

--max-objects.help: Maximum objects to scan per bucket

--max-resources-per-region.help: Maximum number of resources to enumerate per region. Set to 0 to enumerate all resources.

--max-rows.help: Maximum rows to sample per table

--max-tables.help: Maximum tables to scan per project

--merged-table.help: Writes a single table for all subscriptions in the tenant. Default writes a table per subscription.

--no-limit.help: Remove the 1000 object-per-bucket scan limit (still only reports sensitive files)

--pmapper-data-basepath.help:
Supply the base path for the pmapper data files (useful if you have copied them from another machine)
Point to the parent directory that contains all of the pmapper data by account numbers. 
	Example: /path/to/com.nccgroup.principalmapper/
	Example: ./pmapperdata/

--policies.help: Store all flagged access policies along with the output

--profiles-list.help: File containing a AWS CLI profile names separated by newlines

--project-list.help: Path to a file containing a list of project IDs separated by newlines

--refresh-cache.help: Force re-enumeration of cached data (cache auto-expires after 24 hours)

--sample-data.help: Sample data from flagged tables and scan content

--skip-admin-check.help: Skip check to determine if role is an Admin

--user.help: Display name of user to query

--userdata.help: Use this flag to retrieve only the userData attribute from EC2 instances.

--verbosity.help:
1 = Print control messages only
2 = Print control messages, module output
3 = Print control messages, module output, and loot file output

--with-policies.help: Analyze bucket policies (this is already done in the resource-trusts command)

--wrap.help: Wrap table to fit in terminal (complicates grepping)

instances.help: Enumerate all instances along with assigned IPs, profiles, and user-data

inventory.help: Gain a rough understanding of size of the account and preferred regions

outbound-assumed-roles.help: Find the roles that have been assumed by principals in this account

pmapper.help: Looks for pmapper data for the account and builds a PrivEsc graph in golang if it exists.

principals.help: Enumerate IAM users and Roles so you have the data at your fingertips

private-service-connect.help: Enumerate Private Service Connect endpoints and service attachments

rbac.help: Display role assignemts for Azure principals

route53.help: Enumerate all records from all zones managed by route53. Get a loot file with A records you can scan

secrets.help: Enumerate secrets from secrets manager and SSM

tui.help: View Cape's output in a TUI

workloads.help: Finds workloads with admin permissions or a path to admin permissions
